title: Ivo and the Summer
author: Vesper Winterbourne
blurb: Astrid Oyelaran, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
